metadata.question: Did vegetation cover increase in Warburton Creek between June 20, 2025 and September 15, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Warburton Creek (in Australia, likely Queensland/South Australia border region) - Date: June 20, 2025 and September 15, 2025 (two specific dates) - Collection: Sentinel-2 (10m resolution, good for vegetation). Fallback to Landsat 8/9 if needed. - Use NDVI as vegetation indicator 2. Masking strategy: - Yes, mask clouds since we need clear vegetation signal - Use QA60 band for Sentinel-2 cloud masking 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error: - Valid Zero: NDVI could legitimately be low (desert/water) - C1: No images found for one or both dates - C2: Images exist but after cloud masking, no valid pixels - C3: NDVI calculation returns None/NaN or out of range (>1 or <-1) - A: NDVI increased between dates - B: NDVI decreased or stayed same ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const warburtonCreek = ee.Geometry.Point([139.5, -26.5]); // Warburton Creek approximate location const buffer = warburtonCreek.buffer(10000); // 10km buffer const date1 = '2025-06-20'; const date2 = '2025-09-15'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // Try Sentinel-2 let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(10, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(10, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`June 2025 Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`September 2025 Images: ${size2}`); // Fallback to Landsat 9 if Sentinel-2 fails if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(10, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(10, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); const ls_size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const ls_size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat9 June: ${ls_size1}, September: ${ls_size2}`); if (ls_size1 === 0 || ls_size2 === 0) { console.log('No data available for one or both dates'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Processing - Cloud masking and NDVI calculation function maskCloudsS2(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask); } function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } // Process collections const img1 = col1.map(maskCloudsS2).map(addNDVI).median(); const img2 = col2.map(maskCloudsS2).map(addNDVI).median(); // Check pixel counts const count1_result = await img1.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const count2_result = await img2.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const count1 = count1_result.NDVI || 0; const count2 = count2_result.NDVI || 0; console.log(`Valid pixels - June: ${count1}, September: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculate mean NDVI const ndvi1_result = await img1.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const ndvi2_result = await img2.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const ndvi1 = ndvi1_result.NDVI; const ndvi2 = ndvi2_result.NDVI; console.log(`June NDVI: ${ndvi1 !== null ? ndvi1.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); console.log(`September NDVI: ${ndvi2 !== null ? ndvi2.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (ndvi1 === null || ndvi2 === null || isNaN(ndvi1) || isNaN(ndvi2) || ndvi1 > 1 || ndvi1 < -1 || ndvi2 > 1 || ndvi2 < -1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI calculation'); console.log('C3'); return; } const change = ndvi2 - ndvi1; console.log(`NDVI Change: ${change.toFixed(3)}`); if (change > 0) { console.log('Vegetation cover increased'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Vegetation cover did not increase'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
